resources.string: KAI Music is an independent modification of Echo Music, an open-source Android music application.

Our journey began with the incredible work of the Echo Music developers and contributors.

Their creativity and dedication to open-source software inspired us to experiment, learn, modify, and continue improving the music listening experience.

KAI builds upon that foundation through independent development, customization, and additional improvements.
Special Thanks to the Original Creator
A sincere thank you to Aditya and every contributor who helped create Echo Music. Your work became the foundation and inspiration behind KAI Music.

The time, creativity, and dedication you invested in open-source development made projects like KAI possible.

Thank you for sharing your work with the community and inspiring others to learn, experiment, and build upon it.

We deeply appreciate your contribution.

KAI is independently modified and maintained by @dipakdhurve9975-lgtm. The KAI player, visual identity and customizations build on the original project. Our maintainer and community links follow below.
